title: Runs: process, state, health gate, start / answer / cancel / abandon (/hub/runs)
what:
Per-run dir and config:
- <home>/runs/<rid>/ holds config.toml: <home>/config.toml through toml parse and display, with sessions_dir set to the run dir and swarm disabled (the key behind cfg.swarm_enabled(), main.rs:1963).
- [policy] is copied unchanged, so a run uses the same policy file and therefore the same shared permits store (permits.rs:78-80; G1 keeps it shared).
- The run's .eid is then the only one there, and runs never join the roster.
Health (moved here from R1b, because the start gate needs it): runs/health.rs.
- GET /hub/runs/health probes --jev-health and --browser-health with a 1 s timeout, cached 5 s.
- J1's ckpt, loaded and decisions_log are passed through verbatim.
Routes:
- GET /hub/runs
- POST /hub/runs {graph, args}: 202 {rid}
  - 400: bad body, args not an object, or args over 64 KiB
  - 404: a graph outside --run-graphs, or one with no workflows/<g>.rn
  - 409 {run}: while any run is running OR parked (one shared Chromium)
  - 409 {why}: unless jev's /health says decisions_log 'off' (ruling 1). A missing field counts as on. The sentence: 'jev is logging decisions for training; restart it with JEV_DECISIONS_LOG=off: <the start command>'
  - 503 {why}: jev or the browser service is down (with its start command), or there is no --home
- GET /hub/runs/<rid>: state running | parked | done | failed | cancelled | abandoned | refused | lost, exit, output tails
- POST /hub/runs/<rid>/answer {text}: at most 1 KiB, no control chars, passed as --answer=<text>; the same decisions_log gate (a resume calls jev); 409 if not parked or a child is alive
- POST /hub/runs/<rid>/cancel: killpg SIGTERM, 5 s grace, then SIGKILL
- POST /hub/runs/<rid>/abandon: parked only; the state becomes abandoned and no child is started
Process:
- The pending.rs pattern: own process group, stdin carries the args JSON (--args -), always --provider mock, never yolo, never the manual config, wall clock MINERVA_PERCH_RUN_MS (default 15 min, read via --knob).
- Lifetime per D3:
  - (a) detach: no kill_on_drop; the Group guard is disarmed; stdout/stderr go to out.log and err.log in the run dir, not pipes; runs::adopt re-finds a live pid whose /proc cmdline names `workflow` and this run dir.
  - (b) on_shutdown sends SIGTERM to the live run and waits 5 s.
- With no live pid, the state comes from the latest WorkflowEnd, reading only `kind` keys. A run with no end is `lost`.
- State lives in <home>/runs.json: 0600, write_atomic_0600; a corrupt file is moved to .bad-<ts>.
tests:
tests/runs.rs, with fake_eidolon replaying F0 fixtures at FAKE_WORKFLOW_STEP_MS. Health test servers run on 127.0.0.1:48140 (jev) and :48141 (browser), in-test only.
- Requests and argv:
  - 401 without a token; `../x` and an unknown graph give 404; array args and 65 KiB args give 400
  - the argv has --provider mock and --args -; no token is in argv or env
  - the per-run config.toml has swarm disabled, sessions_dir set to the run dir, and [policy] identical to config.toml's
  - an answer of -1 arrives as --answer=-1
- Health gate:
  - decisions_log 'off' lets a start through
  - a path value, a missing field (old /health) and jev down each refuse, with the sentence and no child started
  - an answer is refused the same way
- Cap and concurrency:
  - a second start while one is parked gives 409 naming it; after abandon, a start succeeds
  - a second answer while resuming gives 409
- Ending a run:
  - cancel: the process group is gone, the state is cancelled and the fake journals WorkflowEnd
  - the wall-clock knob kills the run
  - (D3 a) SIGTERM to the perch leaves the child running; the restarted perch adopts it; after `kill -9` of the child, the state comes from the log
- runs.json is 0600 and a corrupt one is set aside.
- Health handles up and down, with J1's fields passed through and an old /health without them.
- The existing secrets-at-trace test still passes.
live_check:
fake perch on PORT=48106 plus curl, with a test jev /health on 48140 saying off:
- start, see parked, answer, done
- then start, park, abandon, start again
- switch the test /health to a path: a start answers 409 with the sentence
risk: Under detach, a run outlives the perch with no wall clock; the host's 200-step cap is the only bound. That is stated in the UI. The gate trusts what jev's /health says; it cannot see the file.
